information_for_contributors: Intentionally minimal placeholder grammar. The full JavaScript grammar was removed to reduce bundle size, as embedded JS highlighting is rarely used.

The adblock grammar embeds this via 'source.js' so inline scriptlet bodies still get a source.js scope. To restore full JS highlighting, add a download entry for this grammar in scripts/update-grammars.mts and run 'pnpm update-grammars'.
name: JavaScript
